name: claude-mods
description: Mods and skills for Claude Code.

plugins.name: auto-approve
plugins.description: Answers permission prompts for you: allows routine tool calls, asks you on risky ones

plugins.name: qboard
plugins.description: Question board: Claude puts open questions on a side pane with stable Q<n> ids, you answer with a click or Q<n> <option>

plugins.name: sidebar
plugins.description: Shows every live Claude Code session as a card in a side pane, with an optional tmux jump
